Interface WhoEvent

All Known Implementing Classes:
CredentialAdded, CredentialRevoked, EmailAddressConfirmationRequested, EndedSessionsPurged, EnrollmentTokenCreated, EnrollmentTokenRevoked, HumanCheckPerformed, IdentityCreated, IdentityDeactivated, IdentityDeleted, IdentityInvited, IdentityReactivated, OrphanedCredentialsPurged, PasskeyRegistrationRefused, RoleAssigned, RoleCreated, RoleDeleted, RolePermissionAdded, RolePermissionRemoved, RoleUnassigned, SessionEnded, SignedOut, SignInEmailRequested, SignInFailed, SignInSucceeded
public interface WhoEvent
A security-relevant occurrence inside who, published through WhoEventPublisher.

Compatibility policy: new event types and new enum values may appear in minor releases. Listeners must tolerate unknown values and ignore event types they do not recognise. Event records may also gain components in minor releases, so read fields through their accessors: do not construct who's events or match them with record deconstruction patterns.
